questions.q: A post-operative patient has been cleared for a 'Clear Liquid Diet'. Which item is allowed?
questions.explain: Clear liquid diets include fluids that are transparent at room temperature (broth, gelatin, tea, apple juice). Milk and ice cream are 'Full Liquid'. OJ with pulp is not clear.
